description: §6.14.4.3 rule 2: a `hold=` whose operand is not a `persist=` cell is E-HOLD-WITHOUT-PERSIST (not a plain DOM attribute).
rationale: §6.14.4.3 rule 2: "**Requires `persist=`.** A `hold=` whose operand is not a `persist=` cell SHALL be `E-HOLD-WITHOUT-PERSIST` (rec 8). A general \"cloak until rendered\" marker for non-persisted content is a separate question, not this attribute"
